claims.assertion: Existing Unknown preserved; a regulator demand for a separate public page has not been verified.
claims.review_note: No private correspondence supplied. Law Article 14 and Annex III establish public accessibility information in general terms or an equivalent document, not a dedicated webpage. No Yes/No inferred.

claims.assertion: Covered service providers must make accessibility information publicly available in accessible written and oral forms throughout service provision.
claims.review_note: Microenterprise service providers are exempt under Article 5(5). This duty is not treated as proof of a dedicated public page. The same isolated review found the final Article 14/Annex III wording supported.

claims.assertion: Service conformity information must also be supplied to the competent authority or market-surveillance authorities on a reasoned request.
claims.review_note: Separate from the public information duty.

claims.assertion: The Deputy Minister of Social Welfare is the competent authority under Law 57(I)/2024.
claims.review_note: Applies across the Act's covered products, services and 112 response. The Council of Ministers may designate public departments and services to support market surveillance; a complete current designation roster was not verified. Isolated Greek-to-English review on 2026-09-24 by /root/cypriot_language (fork_turns=none) found the final Article 3 wording supported after narrowing: the Deputy Minister is the competent authority; Council-designated departments cooperate and conduct surveillance.
